action_items: Optional: Reconcile starter slug naming between problem-statement docs (underscored) and actual seed data (hyphenated). Currently hyphenated everywhere in code + tests + frontend testids — recommend updating docs.
Suggest E2E verification of ProjectDetailPage TemplatePicker integration (not directly exercised in this iteration — same shared component is reused per files_of_reference, low risk).
critical_code_review_comments: routers/templates.py is clean and well-structured: proper UUID guard, locale resolution with en-US fallback chain, tenant-or-platform visibility filter, audit_log on all mutations, permission gating via require_permission(P_MOODBOARDS_READ/WRITE). No mongo _id leaks (Supabase). Pydantic schemas validate all inputs.

apply_template correctly omits the non-existent 'settings' column on moodboards insert (this was the P0 bug fixed in this phase) and mirrors content.src → image_url for image blocks for runtime parity with create_block.

save_as_template writes settings: {} to moodboard_templates table — verify that this column EXISTS on moodboard_templates (it likely does per migration 006 — V2 scaffold). If it doesn't, save-as would 500. Backend test passed so column is present.

TemplatePicker.jsx is 100% Blueprint-driven (no hardcoded copy/colors, all via t() and var(--bp-*)). Locale forwarded to /api/templates so server localizes name/description. Good separation of concerns — parent decides /api/moodboards (blank) vs /api/templates/{id}/apply (template).
RBAC test confirmed client gets 403 BEFORE the moodboard lookup happens (permission gate fires first via FastAPI dependency) — correct ordering.
